SELECT p.id AS paymentId, p.payment_type AS paymentType, p.target_id AS targetId, p.amount AS amount, c.name AS paymentStatus, pm.name AS paymentMethod, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.created_at AS createdAt, CASE -- 테마: 결제 완료 + 미사용일 때 환불 가능 WHEN c.code = 'PS02' AND p.payment_type = 'THEME' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM theme_purchase tp WHERE tp.payment_id = p.id AND tp.is_used = FALSE ) THEN TRUE
-- 구독: 결제 완료 상태라면 언제든 환불 가능 WHEN c.code = 'PS02' AND p.payment_type = 'SUBSCRIPTION' THEN TRUE
ELSE FALSE END AS refundAvailable FROM payment p JOIN common_code c ON p.status_id = c.id LEFT JOIN common_code pm ON p.pay_method_id = pm.id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.type = 1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 1 AND code = 'PS05' AND is_active = TRUE ) WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 1 AND code = 'PS02' ) AND ( ( payment_type = 'THEME' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM theme_purchase tp WHERE tp.payment_id = payment.id AND tp.is_used = FALSE ) ) OR payment_type = 'SUBSCRIPTION' )
